metadata.prompt_tuning_prohibition: No production prompt tuning is permitted after the first holdout run.

curation_notes: This holdout uses source-local synthetic biomedical cases that are not quoted in the production prompt or the current development fixture.
Absent qualifiers use the existing fixture convention of omission, which the loader materializes as NOT_APPLICABLE.
Cases tagged source_measurement contain literal numeric source evidence; the existing fixture schema has no separate expected source_measurements field.
